csv_project_name: Design for MN 100 - Cedar Lk Rd Pavement & Bridge Rehab
csv_scope_of_work: The State of Minnesota , Department of Transportation , may be seeking a Consultant to Provide a mill/overlay and CPR project on TH 100 from W 26th St in St Louis Park to TH 694 in Brooklyn Center. The project includes extensive replacement of sidewalk and curb ramps to meet ADA standards and signal replacement. Additional geometric changes to the corridor may be included to enhance safety. This contract will take over plan development after the 60% plan submittal and complete the work necessary to deliver the final plan for letting, as well as modeling and analyzing TMP alternatives and selecting a proposed staging plan and providing construction support.
